parameters.value: DNA Capillary Sequencer is used in genetic analysis and research, primarily utilizing capillary electrophoresis for the separation, sequencing and identification of DNA fragments.
Fluorescence-based DNA Sequencing, Polymer based DNA Sequencing

Re-sequencing, Long Read Sequencing, Comparative Sequencing, Amplified Fragment Length Polymorphism, Microsatellite, Long Sizing, SNP Validation and Screening, Linkage Analysis, Short Tandem Repeat Typing
96-well standard plate, 384-well plates, 8 well tube strips

Sequencing analysis software, Variant analysis software, Microbial identification software, Quality control software, Genotyping analysis software, Minor Variants Software, MSI Analysis Software, NGS Variants confirmation software, Fragment Analysis

2 year from the date of satisfactory commissioning of the machine
